A_study_holdout_exclusive.description: Test = peptides whose only eligible study is this one; train = all other pos-only/neg-only peptides. Multi-study peptides stay in train.
A_study_holdout_exclusive.leakage_note: n_train_peptides_also_in_this_study counts multi-study peptides kept in train that were also assayed by the held-out study (study-level leakage).

B_sequence_holdout_hamming1.description: Each Hamming<=1 same-length component is a group; held-out components form test.
B_sequence_holdout_hamming1.graph_built_on: pos-only/neg-only peptides only (mixed peptides excluded; they could bridge components)
B_sequence_holdout_hamming1.note: Component sizes are small, so the 20% target is met to within one component (n_test overshoots target by at most the largest component size).

C_study_and_sequence.description: Peptides exclusive to one study AND in a singleton Hamming<=1 component.

note: Exploratory partition feasibility. pos/neg are descriptive outcome patterns, not V2 labels.
